provenance.note: The profile is not published on the payloads main branch, so the app cannot resolve it from the online manifest. The exploit base comes from upstream PR #320 commit a311cb88c28204c3902af9450ae4077199e4d71d; the bundled bytes add the rt_mutex PI-guard fix (upstream PR #320 code plus sched fire/fired triage logs gated off by default (SLIDE_SCHED_DIAG), skip sched_setattr when waiter tid unpublished). Rebuilt with NDK r29 API 35 (make TARGET=e1q-S9210ZHS6DZG1 ANDROID_NDK_HOME=<ndk-r29> release), bit-identical across rebuilds. EXPERIMENTAL v3.3.0: ksud is the e1q Phase-D pair from Root-My-Galaxy-Payloads commit 8236c84301282b5415412d867ab71d4a739e0809, built with CONFIG_KSU_SAMSUNG_NO_PATCH_TEXT=y and statically audited. The pre-fix bytes had two full-chain Shizuku-mode runs on SM-S9210 (2026-10-03 attempt 1/24, 2026-10-07 attempt 11/24); the PI-guard bytes in this manifest had one successful full-chain Shizuku-mode run on 2026-10-19 (attempt 15/24), with the Manager UI status captured; a later resetprop read/set/delete pass on the pinned ksud succeeded, so repeatability and reboot persistence remain unverified. Provenance history: the original fetch pin referenced the samson910022/Root-My-Galaxy-Payloads fork (main@e90759c5e4167f271ef46cc4a57835cf42a2ffc6), which disappeared in November 2026; tools/sync-payloads.sh was repointed on 2026-11-19 to byte-identical bytes at Root-My-Galaxy-Payloads-Next commit e3a578d3342e266b6f26434147abe2697f350a0a (verified by SHA-256).
provenance.schemaVersionRationale: The online feed is owned upstream and pins remote artifacts by url; this file is owned by this repository and pins them by asset path plus digest, so the two are versioned independently rather than sharing one number that would describe two different shapes. Version 4 also carries fields the online feed has no use for: an exact kernelReleases gate, and a digest that replaces no upstream field.
provenance.requiresFreshP0SessionNote: The upstream manifest entry sets requiresFreshP0Session to true and that value is preserved here verbatim, but the app does not implement it and the bundled payload does not enforce it either: src/targets/e1q-S9210ZHS6DZG1/target.h does not define APP_REQUIRE_FRESH_P0_SESSION, so src/preload.c takes the branch that retains a discovered P0 offset and injects it into the next child. The porting record documents the env as EXPLOIT_ATTEMPTS=24 and separately reports the golden run completing on attempt 5/48; it does not contain a supervisor-retained diagnostic, so it does not establish that the retention branch was actually exercised. Treat this field as upstream metadata, not as a behavioural contract.
